notes.title: Tons of Quality-of-Life Improvements and Fixes!
notes.content:
[list]
		[*]Added specials to the store, including player-choice Power Pack and a variety pack of boosts
		[*]Increased gold earned when playing Airship multiple times in a day
		[*]In-door environments now use a toy road for paths
		[*]Towers can now be toggled to stop attacking
		[*]Players can now archive Upgrades: keep them around, but don’t show them in battle. Coming soon: increase the star level of your existing Upgrades!
		[*]Hero and Tower max levels have increased so all stats can be properly maxed out
		[*]Hero and tower experience now roll over past promotion levels
		[*]If a hero or tower is already at max level and a reward is given for that hero/tower XP, it will be changed to gems
		[*]Added a ‘back’ button for VIP/PC merchant, so you can go back to a previously generated upgrade (no more accidentally skipping an upgrade you’re looking for)
		[*]Junk Mills drop junk a bit closer to themselves
		[*]Beetle’ Shockwave ability now deals Breaker damage
		[*]Bosses no longer teleport super close to food stash
		[*]Non-robot boss abilities are now visible on their boss window
		[*]Enemy Food Stash firecracker turrets do not target the food stash unless all heroes are dead
		[*]Players can no longer get a sidequest to build X towers if there is a level condition limiting building towers
		[*]Pack Ant now makes decisions quicker when constantly picking up junk
		[*]Fixed a bug where the mouse wouldn’t work on MacOS version
		[*]Fixed the airship showing/giving the wrong amounts of gold when playing multiple times in a day
		[*]Fixed a bug where the camera could go through walls
		[*]Fixed a bug with hero ultimates being charged instantly
		[*]Fixed a bug with Slug’s Barrage Upgrade not doing anything
		[*]Fixed a bug where an enemy Food Stash from a quest wouldn’t spawn on a disabled airship location
		[*]Added account transfer in the options menu (iOS and Android only)
		[*]Various game polish and UX improvements
		[*]Optimizations
	[/list]

notes.title: Apr 19, 2024, v10005
notes.content:
[b]Apr 19, 2024, v10005[/b]

[list]
[*]Reduced the difficulty of Ambush and Adventure battles
[*]Fixed a bug with boss health at Wave 200+ on Airship
[*]Fixed a bug when loading a mid-game save on airship (player’s towers/upgrades would not load properly)
[*]Heroes will no longer auto-move towards their marked target if the player manually moves at all
[*]Heroes will now auto-attack nearby enemies if their marked target is not in range, unless they are aut-moving to their target
[*]Spider can now use Ninja Smoke between waves
[*]Other small improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes - Apr 9, 2024 - v10003
notes.content:
View the full log here:
[url=https://www.foursakenmedia.com/changelog.php?game=bhtd_pc]https://www.foursakenmedia.com/changelog.php?game=bhtd_pc[/url]


[b]Game[/b]
	[list]
	[*]Added Overcharge: after reaching 10 stars in battle, power up a hero or tower and add up to 20 stars of upgrades!
	[*]Players are now restricted to 50 towers in battle at a time
	[*]Players are now restricted to 40 allied bugs from the Food Stash at a time, extras will be queued and spawn later when they can
	[*]New pause window, now includes level info, quests, missions, and a battle map
	[*]Junk earned from wave completions decreases at waves 150+ and 250+
	[*]Adjusted boss damage and health
	[*]Slug’s health, speed, and clip size slightly increased
	[*]Fixed a bug affecting allied creep damage negatively, especially in airship
	[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
	[list]
	[*]Knocker upgrades now work correctly for Slug
	[*]Automatically collect the double gold/keys after a battle if Premium Game+ has been purchased (free version)
	[*]Fixed a bug where enemies could spawn in strange places in non-TD modes
	[*]Fixed a bug where hero health/gold medal indicator wouldn’t show during Ambush battles
	[*]Fixed a bug where build tower quests could be instantly completed by loading a battle
	[*]Fixed a bug where heroes could get stuck moving on the edge of a map
	[*]If a boss is killed off the path on Airship while the heroes stay on path scenario is active, the boss crate will now appear on the path instead of being unreachable
	[*]Enemies no longer ignore heroes on the very edge of some maps
	[*]The game now pauses when a controller is connected or disconnected
	[*]Fixed a boot up crash related to the scenario where the user has a special or accented character in their home folder
	[*]Added a band-aid fix to when our few server calls cause the app to be terminated. After crashing once due to our server calls, subsequent bootups should bypass the issue and allow the player to get into the game successfully.
	[/list]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest is here!
notes.content:
Hello! Steam Next Fest is here and we're excited to launch the Bug Heroes: Tower Defense demo! The Demo includes 3 levels, 2 heroes, and a variety of turrets and upgrades. Additionally, the demo fully supports Steam Deck.

FULL GAME FEATURES
[list]
[*] 10 unique heroes
[*] Dozens of towers to customize your build
[*] Mix of action and tower defense gameplay
[*] Zoom into the action and play in 3rd person
[*] In depth upgrades and progression
[*] And tons more!
[/list]
Please check out our [url=https://discord.gg/foursaken]Discord[/url] channel to give us feedback and discuss the game with other players. 

Thanks for playing, and don't forget to Wishlist if you enjoy the demo!

tags.feature: The Demo includes 3 levels, 2 heroes, and a variety of turrets and upgrades.
Additionally, the demo fully supports Steam Deck.
